verdict.rationale: VPM documents on-site shredding of unwanted mail with destruction certificates available on request, which covers confirmation of shredding. It also documents per-mail choices to skip opening or scanning and have items shipped instead, plus automation rules for how mail is handled. Missing for 10: any documented physical-mail storage window or retention period (the 'unlimited cloud storage' refers to scans, not physical items), an explicit per-item shred-on-request workflow, a full menu of disposal options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
